label: rem:flavor-split-substrate-interpretation
title: Reading and Bring-surface origin of the flavor-split formula
html:
Under the pair-Skein mass formula and the substrate ansatz for the per-quark split (Steps 1, 2 and 6 of the proof, using the half-argument weight (q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2})^{-1}), the left-hand side of the identity is the substrate formula for the proton–neutron splitting (m_n - m_p)/M_N, with M_N = (m_p + m_n)/2. As a function it depends only on q, but it inherits the ansatz of Step 2, which was chosen partly for its agreement with the measured splitting. Without the factor 1/3, the right-hand side \hbar_q^2 \cdot h_q \cdot [2]_q is the same splitting per quark, (m_n - m_p)/\mu_{\text{avg}}.

The factored form admits a categorical reading:

Factor Categorical meaning
\hbar_q^2 Two quanta of substrate Planck action
h_q One Hecke crossing
[2]_q Doublet quantum integer

The flavor swap \mathfrak{u} \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{d} acts via the Hecke generator \sigma.

Remark (Bring-surface origin).

The closed form emerges from per-sheet Picard–Lefschetz integration on the Bring color-tube cubic. The 1/3 factor reflects the permutation average over three flavor placements.
